claims.object_text: absence of complete consciousness loss and rapid postictal recovery despite prolonged seizures
claims.quote: Non-epileptic seizures can be distinguished from epileptic seizures by the absence of complete consciousness loss and rapid postictal recovery despite prolonged seizures.
Ketogenic diet therapy was effective in 33 of 43 (77%) non-epileptic seizures.
Providing supplementary food before high-impact exercise or during attacks prevented or mitigated non-epileptic seizures in some individuals.
